caption: Figure 14.4 Electron Transport System (ETS)
note: Subscripts, superscripts and the printed fraction are written flat here (2e-, UQH2, Cyt C1, bc1, CuA, CuB, Cyta3, H2O, Fo, F1, Pi; "1/2O2 + 2H+" is printed as a stacked one-half followed by O2 + 2H+). "Cyt b" and the "c" in "(Cytochrome bc1)" are printed in italics. Several identical labels (e-, UQ, UQH2, Cyt c, 4H+, 2H+) occur more than once at different points in the diagram and each occurrence is listed. A row of "+" signs and dashes marks the membrane charge at the foot of the figure; these are symbols, not label text, so they are not listed. The left-hand column of body prose, clipped at the crop edge, is a neighbouring block and is excluded, as is the page number "233".
